text.単なる修繕のためのリフォームや、家族の変化のための住替えなど、私達のサービスは単: Whether the work is repair, or a move prompted by a change in the family, what we do is not simply making rooms. It is bringing new value to the way you see things and the way you live. To make a home that does that, we believe what matters is not only our proposals as professionals but the conversation with you, and the trust built up on both sides through it.
text.私達の住まいに対する知識や経験、実際の施工物件などをご確認頂きながら、お客様それ: You are welcome to examine what we know, what we have done, and the homes we have actually built, as we work with you towards your own “Timeless Living”.
text.Step1～4までは無料にて承ります。: Steps 1 to 4 are free of charge.
text.どのようなリフォームがご希望か、まずは理想の住まいについてお聞かせください。お部: Tell us first what kind of renovation you have in mind and what the ideal home would be. We visit the apartment, photograph it and take measurements. If you have drawings, please have them to hand.
text.物件の建築的条件や管理組合の規約など、リフォームに際しての調査を行います。躯体や: We investigate what governs the work: the building’s structural conditions, the rules of the building management association. Having checked the state of the structural frame and the services, we judge how far the renovation can go.
text.間取り、設備、素材、内装デザインなど具体的なご提案をいたします。: We put forward specific proposals — the plan, the fittings, the materials, the interior design.
text.打合せを重ねながら、詳細なプランニングを進めてまいります。: Through a series of meetings we work the plan up in detail.
text.（この際に設計着手金を頂戴致します）: (A design retainer is payable at this stage.)
text.詳細なプランを基に、再度お見積りを提示いたします。: On the basis of the detailed plan we present a further quotation.
text.プラン・予算が確定しましたら、ご契約いただき当社管理のもと施工を行います。: Once the plan and the budget are settled, we sign a contract and build the work under our own site management.
text.工事完了後に、リフォームの仕上がりをご確認頂き、お引渡しいたします。ご入居後のア: When the work is finished you inspect it, and we hand the home over. Aftercare once you have moved in is handled by us directly.
